**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/18 (Sat) 20:47
- [USER] User inquired about the new US $100 bill.
- [FACT] User asked if the new US $100 bill has 2 pockets embedded along the vertical blue line.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The new US $100 bill does not have two pockets embedded along the vertical blue line.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The most recent design of the US $100 bill was released in 2013.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The US $100 bill features a blue security strip that runs vertically down the right-hand side of the bill.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The blue security strip contains images of bells and 100s that move and change as the bill is tilted.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The blue security strip does not have any pockets or other physical features embedded within it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The blue security strip is one of several anti-counterfeiting measures included in the design of the new $100 bill.
